name: crit
description: Have the agent build, benchmark and serve a bespoke LLM inference engine tuned to your own NVIDIA GPU: CUDA kernels, quantization, speculative decoding and KV-cache techniques, checked for quality with crit Eval and served through an OpenAI-compatible API.

interface.shortDescription: Build a faster LLM inference engine for your GPU
interface.longDescription: crit has the agent build a bespoke inference engine for one open LLM on your own NVIDIA GPU: it profiles the device, tunes CUDA kernels, tries quantization, speculative decoding and KV-cache techniques, measures every candidate's speed and quality with crit Eval, and serves the best one through an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost.
defaultPrompt: Build me a fast engine for Qwen3.8-27B on this GPU, and serve the best candidate.
Run Eval on candidate-0003 and tell me which gates it fails and why.
